Prof Walter

Unfortunately that Excel macro was written by someone outside our group.  I do not believe it has been updated to keep up with more modern versions of Excel.

As an alternative, you can employ the R package to produce detection function and histogram plots to your specification using the sample R script found in the Distance Users Guide in Chapter 8, conventional distance sampling.  You simply "right click" on the detection function plot of interest when this message appears

to save the plotting information to the Windows clipboard, then follow the instructions below.
